capabilities: Lists all vault tasks in a queryable sidebar timeline view
Checks tasks by clicking checkboxes in the view
Quick-edits tasks via right-click menu and left-click popup
Re-schedules tasks, sets priority, adds or removes tags
Renders sub-tasks in collapsible containers with custom tag icons
disambiguation: Not just a task search view; it also edits tasks in place through right-click menus and left-click popups.
extras: README references screenshots (shown as removed images) and leaves the 'Special Task Types' section as an empty heading.
intentEvidence: TaskFinder builds upon the icon-syntax introduced by the Tasks plugin.
problem: Tasks are scattered across notes, so there is no single queryable view to inspect, check and edit them all at once.

relations.evidence: TaskFinder builds upon the icon-syntax introduced by the Tasks plugin.

summary: Sidebar plugin that finds, filters and edits all vault tasks in a queryable timeline view, building on the Tasks plugin's icon syntax.
